draft_en.subject: PoE switches and gigabit media converters for the Dahua systems you sell
draft_en.body:
Hello Obserwuj team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 1 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switches and media converters you list with Dahua systems: an 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP L2+ managed switch, Marvell-based, neutral packing, CE/RoHS - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); an industrial mini Gigabit media converter with SFP slot, STI-110GE, is $26.5. SFP optics we do not supply.

One question: which PoE port count do your installer customers buy most - 4, 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
